(dibrompropamidine) Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Dibrompropamidine Diisetionate). A white or al- most white, crystalline powder. Freely soluble or soluble in wa- ter; slightly soluble in alcohol; practically insoluble in dichlo- romethane. A 5% solution in water has a pH of 5.0 to 6.0. Profile Dibrompropamidine isetionate is an aromatic diamidine antisep- tic similar to propamidine (p.1660). It is bactericidal against Gram-positive bacteria but is less active against Gram-negative bacteria and spore-forming organisms. It also has antifungal properties.
